test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They had been assigning the interns multiple tasks quietly.

options.text: The interns had been assigned multiple tasks quietly.
Multiple tasks were assigned by interns quietly.
The interns were assigning tasks quietly.
Tasks had been quietly assigning interns.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They had been assigning the interns multiple tasks quietly."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the interns" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had been assigning" to "had been assigned" (past perfect continuous passive).
 
• Ensure the adverb "quietly" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The interns had been assigned multiple tasks quietly."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Multiple tasks were assigned by interns quietly." – Incorrect subject placement and passive structure.
 
• **Option 3: **"The interns were assigning tasks quietly." – Active voice, not passive.
 
• **Option 4: **"Tasks had been quietly assigning interns." – Incorrect sentence structure.
